data.title: Postings without a fillable requisition, measured on one ATS platform (Greenhouse)
data.summary: A hiring platform reports that in any given quarter 18–22% of the roles posted through it are classified by the vendor as postings not attached to a search that can be filled, and pairs this with a survey of 2,500 workers in the US, UK and Germany in which 61% said they had heard nothing after an interview. The first figure is the vendor's own classification of its own customers' postings and is not independently auditable; the second is a self-reported recollection, not a matched record. Together they establish that a posting's existence does not imply a live requisition behind it — not any proportion for the market as a whole.
data.citation: Greenhouse 2024 State of Job Hunting report. Platform classification of ghost jobs and survey of 2,500 workers across the US, UK and Germany.
